source.name: The New York Times
source.quote: Setting a record price for the naming rights to an American indoor sports arena, the British bank Barclays has agreed to pay nearly $400 million over 20 years
source.note: January 2007 announcement of the deal for the arena then being built; the record’s start date is still open.

note: Arena naming rights: Barclays Center. Start date unknown: the record said 2026 (the season it was recorded), its source is from 2007-01-18.
